entries: keep your arms T-rex short
keep one eye closed
one thumb must be pointing up at all times
you can only speak in questions
you may only whisper
no 'um,' 'uh,' 'like,' or 'you know'
every sentence must end in a rhyme
no direct eye contact with anyone
don't say anyone's name
no swearing
speak at half volume
every time you laugh, say 'I accept that'
clap once every time someone says your name
snap twice before you start any sentence
keep your arms crossed at all times
speak only in a monotone. No inflection whatsoever
no using your hands to gesture while you speak
refer to yourself in the third person. No 'I' or 'me'
answer every question with a question
you can only respond with yes or no
